prompt:
Rewrite snippets/warehouse-availability-list.liquid so it renders a stock-by-warehouse list with first/last markers. Input (top-level variable only, no section settings): - `warehouses`: array of objects, or null. It may be empty. Each object has `name` (string, never null) and `quantity` (integer, never null). Output: - If `warehouses` is null or an empty array, output nothing (empty string). - Otherwise output `
    `, then one `
  • ` per warehouse in input order, then `
`. - Each item is `
  • NAME: QUANTITY
    • `. NAME is the warehouse name passed through the `escape` filter. QUANTITY is the integer as-is. There is exactly one space after the colon. - CLASSES always starts with `warehouse`. The first item appends ` warehouse--first`. The last item appends ` warehouse--last`. A list with a single item gets both, in that order: `warehouse warehouse--first warehouse--last`. - Emit no whitespace or newlines between or around any tags. The whole output is one line with no leading or trailing whitespace. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/warehouse-availability-list.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
